description: Add 'Retido' status globally, update backend stats to count it, add 'Retidos' KPI card in cancelamentos header, and create backend functions getDashboardData() and getSuspensosMetrics() for charts data
steps: In apps-script/Code.gs: Add 'Retido' status counting in getStats() function - add 'retidos' field to the stats object counting records where statusAtual.toLowerCase() === 'retido'

In apps-script/Code.gs: Create getDashboardData() function that returns: (a) retention pie chart data: count of 'Retido' vs 'Cancelado', (b) daily line chart data: for each unique date in DATA DE CRIACAO column, count total records, cancelados, and retidos for that day, (c) productivity table: for each unique atendente, count total records, cancelados, and retidos attributed to them

In apps-script/Code.gs: Create getSuspensosMetrics() function that returns: (a) totalPlacas: count of all records with non-empty PLACA, (b) valoresAReceber: sum of VALOR ORIGINAL column (parse numeric), (c) valorRecebido: sum of VALOR RECEBIDO column only where CONFERENCIA === 'OK', (d) operatorPerformance: array of {atendente, valorOriginal, valorRecebido (only where conf=OK), totalAtendimentos}
In apps-script/Index.html: Add 'Retido' option to the status filter dropdown (id='filter-status') and to the form status select (id='f-status')
In apps-script/Index.html: Expand the cancelamentos stats grid from 4 columns to 5 (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5) and add a new card for 'Retidos' with id='stat-retidos' using orange/amber color theme
In apps-script/Index.html: Update the loadData() function's getStats success handler to also populate the stat-retidos element
In apps-script/Index.html: Update the stClass() function to add styling for 'retido' status (use amber/orange colors: bg-amber-900/40 text-amber-300)
acceptance_criteria: getStats() returns a 'retidos' field counting records with status 'Retido'
getDashboardData() function exists and returns pieData, lineData, and productivityData
getSuspensosMetrics() function exists and returns totalPlacas, valoresAReceber, valorRecebido, and operatorPerformance
'Retido' appears in the status filter dropdown and in the form modal status select
A fifth KPI card 'Retidos' appears in the cancelamentos stats section
stClass() returns appropriate amber/orange classes for 'retido' status
verification: Grep for 'retido' in Code.gs to confirm getStats counts it
Grep for 'getDashboardData' in Code.gs to confirm function exists
Grep for 'getSuspensosMetrics' in Code.gs to confirm function exists
Grep for 'stat-retidos' in Index.html to confirm the KPI card exists
Grep for 'Retido' in the filter-status and f-status select areas in Index.html
findings: All 7 steps implemented successfully. getStats() now returns retidos field. getDashboardData() groups by date using dd/MM/yyyy format from column J and returns pieData/lineData/productivityData. getSuspensosMetrics() reads directly from DB_Suspensos sheet with parseCurrency() helper that handles both R$ 150,00 and 150.00 formats. Frontend updated with Retido in both dropdowns, 5-col grid with amber-themed card, and stClass() amber styling.
